title: Thambi
desc: Parvathy is hesitant to accept her brother, Saravanan, who returns home after 15 years. Soon, she discovers that not everything is as it seems and uncovers a well-planned conspiracy.

title: Por Thozhil
desc: With limited evidence in a race against time, two police officers must combine their skills and experience to arrest a psychopath targeting women.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.

title: Naveena Thenali
desc: Tenali Ramakrishna, a lawyer who loses cases for profit, fights for justice in one such case.

title: Hitler
desc: Selva's move to Chennai for work leads to unexpected involvement in crime. As the city falls into disarray, a dishonest politician manoeuvres for control.

title: Race Gurram
desc: In an attempt to put an end to the schemes of their enemy, two brothers join forces and stop at nothing to destroy the reign of a gangster who aspires to be a politician.

title: Raja Raja Dhan
desc: Raja, a visually impaired young man, steps in to save Lucky from a gangster's deadly pursuit. Subsequently, touched by his unwavering courage and kindness, Lucky falls in love.

title: Mister
desc: When Chai finds out that Meera loves Siddharth, he does everything in his power to unite them, even though he is madly in love with her.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Run Baby Run
desc: A man reluctantly agrees to help a medical student who is in trouble by sheltering her in his apartment. However, trouble ensues when she is found dead the next morning.

title: Thuppakki Munai
desc: Birla Bose, an encounter specialist, takes on a rape and murder case in Rameswaram. Upon discovering the accused's innocence, he embarks on a quest to uncover the true perpetrators.

title: Silukkuvarpatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Vaazhai
desc: Forced into labour to repay family debts, young Sivanaindhan grapples with severe hardships brought on by extreme poverty.

title: Aruvam
desc: A woman with anosmia experiences paranormal events and soon finds herself involved in a series of mysterious murders linked to food adulteration.

title: Surya's Saturday
desc: Surya, a young man with anger issues, channels his emotions on Saturdays, because of a promise to his deceased mother. However, things get complicated when he decides to confront a corrupt cop.

title: Sathuranga Vettai
desc: A cunning fraudster profits from deceiving numerous victims. However, trouble ensues when a criminal group seeks revenge against his betrayal.
